title: GenesisSeedRecoveryRunbook
description: Fail-closed machine-readable runbook for observing, reconciling, and recovering a Genesis/DR seed through one provider-neutral bootstrap state machine.

_meta.purpose: Define one resumable bootstrap and recovery contract without turning provider identifiers, shell procedures, or unimplemented components into domain authority.
_meta.enforcement_status: JSON Schema validation is required; the owned Rust reconciler and transition-receipt gate are not implemented.
_meta.versioning_policy: Incompatible changes to intent, phase, receipt, safety, or rollback semantics require a major version.

engineering_rigor.maintainability: Stable phase and failure identifiers separate policy from adapters and implementation.
engineering_rigor.observability: Each transition declares required evidence, success, failure, and receipt semantics.
engineering_rigor.scalability: The same intent and port model applies to one seed or many independent cells without shared runtime membership.
engineering_rigor.performance: Bootstrap work is bounded and asynchronous; it is never in a serving request path.
engineering_rigor.optimization: Reconciliation resumes at the first incomplete phase and rejects blind recreation.
engineering_rigor.code_quality: Closed schemas, independent review, fault injection, and explicit nonclaims are mandatory.
